answer_2.quote: We calculate the distance between the two distributions using three metrics: 1) F1 Score: the harmonic mean of Precision and Recall . Precision estimates the average sample quality, while Recall measures the coverage of the sample distribution. 2) Fréchet Inception Distance (FID): FID calculates the feature-wise mean and covariance matrices of the embedding vectors and then measures the Fréchet distance between the two sets . 3) MAUVE: MAUVE compares the distributions of the synthetic and original data using divergence frontiers .
